# Visin

> Visin is an open-source, self-hosted platform for computer vision work: training runs and their metrics, test results, benchmarks, prediction frames, datasets and labeling. A training script sends its results over an HTTP API with a project token; people and tools read them back with a user API key; AI assistants connect over MCP.

Every deployment is its own: addresses below are this deployment's. Examples in the docs use `http://localhost:4010` for a local `docker compose up`.

## Docs

- [Integrate with Visin](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs): Send training runs from your own scripts, read results back, and connect an assistant.
- [Quickstart](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs/quickstart): Send a training run from a script and see it charted. About ten minutes.
- [Authentication](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs/authentication): Which credential to use, what it can reach, and what the errors mean.
- [Sending results](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs/sending-results): What an epoch can carry, which names the charts read, and what Visin finds by itself.
- [Test results and benchmarks](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs/test-results-and-benchmarks): Scores on held-out data by condition and class, and how fast a model runs.
- [Prediction frames](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs/prediction-frames): Store the images a run renders, and see them epoch by epoch.
- [Errors, limits and pages](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs/errors-and-limits): What a failed request answers, what to retry, how much you can send, and paging through lists.
- [Connecting an assistant](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/docs/assistants): Let Claude or another MCP client read your runs, with only the access you choose.

## API reference

- [Runs and results](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/openapi/vision.json): OpenAPI 3.1 spec of vision-service: runs, epochs, test results, benchmarks, visualizations, comparisons, findings, projects and project tokens.
- [API keys and OAuth](__LANDING_FRONT_URL__/openapi/auth.json): OpenAPI 3.1 spec of auth-service's public API: user API keys, OAuth for assistants, connected apps and assistant activity.
